title: Wandering the Thornwold/Iron Downs border wood (Spoil Verge, Deer Break, Root Tangle, Ford Approach, Clawed Rock, Heartwood Hollow, Bramble Break) never surfaced a path to the actual 'Iron Downs'/Cinderhall hold despite ~25 turns of exploration; the region felt like unfinished or extremely deep content relative to its narrative prominence (two companion quests point there).
where: Thornwold western wood, en route to Iron Downs
